scripts.prepackage:linux: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'linux' || process.arch !== 'x64' || process.versions.node.split('.')[0] !== '24') { console.error('package:linux requires Node.js 24 on Linux x64'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run bundle:sea && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && cp "$(command -v node)" dist/chatgpt-tui-linux-x64 && postject dist/chatgpt-tui-linux-x64 NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea/chatgpt-tui.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2
scripts.shebang: echo '#!/usr/bin/env node' | cat - dist/index.js > temp && mv temp dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.deploy:patch: npm run build && npm run shebang && npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.deploy:minor: npm run build && npm run shebang && npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.deploy:major: npm run build && npm run shebang && npm version major && npm publish --access public
